findings.summary: The run committed only an SVG and produced no rendered PNG anywhere in its run directory or worktree, and the review dispatch named no PNG to judge: the source node's brief requires it to render each figure to PNG and look at it before committing, and the commit itself adds the 44-line SVG markup with no drawing script that a reviewer could trace to a render, so the figure has never been visually verified and this review cannot give a visual verdict on it. The defect does not hold the reviewed node, whose page renders the SVG directly, but the figure review it requested is unanswerable until a rendered PNG is attached.
